name: Prawns and dates
story: Almost all our prawns come in at Chaliyam, where the Chaliyar meets the sea, a short drive from the kitchen. These ones were cooked the morning after they landed.
yourJar: The jar number is written by hand on the label. Jar 9 of 22 means yours was the ninth out of this pot.

ingredients.name: compounded asafoetida (gum arabic, wheat flour, asafoetida)

allergens: Contains crustacean (prawns), sesame, wheat (gluten) and mustard.
claims: No added preservatives. Prepared by traditional method.
storage: A cool, dry place away from sunlight. Always a clean dry spoon, and keep the prawns covered in oil.
bestBefore: Best before six months from packing, so until 4 March 2027.
